Food & beverage · Lahore

NY212

Three-month paid strategy
Across Shalimar, DHA, Guj, JT & Lake City locations

NY212 needed dine-in awareness and deal-driven conversion running at the same time, across five Lahore locations, without the two campaigns competing for the same budget.

Over three months that meant 65 campaigns — some built for reach, most built to sell a specific deal — with weekly rebalancing toward whichever offer was actually moving.

Fashion e-commerce

Signature.pk

Messaging + purchase campaigns
Running in parallel

Signature.pk's shoppers wanted to ask questions before they bought, so the campaigns were split: one track built for DM conversations, one built to take a warm shopper straight to checkout.

The messaging track kept cost-per-conversation low while the purchase track carried the ad spend — together they gave the store both a sales channel and a service channel that paid for itself.

5,749

10.5%
Peak click-through rate

"Split the budget so the DM shoppers and the checkout shoppers stopped competing with each other — that's where the 5.3× came from."

Approach, in short: two funnels, one budget, weekly reallocation toward whichever converted at the lower cost that week.

Solar energy · Lead generation

FasTech

Meta lead ads
Handed straight to the sales team

Solar installation isn't an impulse buy — the job was to get a qualified inquiry, not just a click. Lead ads collected the details a sales call actually needs: rough electricity bill and system size wanted, from 6kW residential setups up to 10kW hybrid systems.

That structure kept cost-per-lead low while still giving the sales team enough context to open the call already knowing what the homeowner needed.
